question:

NEAR : PVZP :: GONE : ILMC :: TAXI : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59cbb7e41a33f704931acef9ed0cf863d728d19c45fc02c7ae244d18a10e1511.png] 

For, GONE : ILMC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/114b4daf1b209fd160f218239a384ee8be13161d4e039c1040edf2ef6bae6d1e.png] 

Similarly, for TAXI : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9032f4af5bb1c1093226468622cfeab09f8ffffafb0f5cc520a34459c6327569.png]
